note: Standalone quarterly results from NSE, five quarters per company. Figures are the parent company only, not the consolidated group, and EPS and debt/equity are often null in this feed - missing stays missing.

cautions.standalone: These are standalone figures. For groups with large subsidiaries the consolidated numbers differ, sometimes a lot.
cautions.five_quarters: Only five quarters are available, so exactly one year-on-year comparison.
cautions.units: Revenue and profit are in Rs crore, converted from NSE's rupee lakh.
